gate_summary: G1 remains incomplete. The owner approved hidden frame-member changes while preserving all 66 panel/kicker screw axes, then limited the design to factory brackets (no lap joints). Seven specific center HL35/HL53 poses, one HL33 pose, one B88 pose, one B66 pose, and one lower-only paired outer-post HL35 trial are rejected; none rejects every bracket layout. In the hybrid, a full-seat upper HL35 row slide cannot contain the first toe bores; a 15-mm shift with a 2.3-mm header extension clears nominal bores but strikes both fixed kicker panels. Resecting six rails clears principal/plate clashes while preserving 66 screw receivers but leaves a 5.55-mm unconnected end gap. The short-bend HL33 pose contains nominal bores but hits unchanged rails; one lower bracket does not establish reversible F1. The paired lower HL35 post pose uses shared post bolts but its 38.1-mm header is below the 88.9-mm catalog minimum. MiTek's B88/B66 DXFs supply nominal geometry, not tolerance, and ESR-3455 forbids applying their C_D=1.6 loads to ordinary duration. BR904 and AB205 remain historical. No architecture is selected, six bolted candidate native cases are unrun, and no fabrication is released. See docs/bolted-candidate-owner-inputs.json and docs/bolted-candidate-prototypes/hardware-first-conditional-screen.md.
diagnostic_progress: Separate pre-gate kerf-right diagnostics now include five converged old-connector proxy cases and one converged left-center nominal AB205 topology case at three provisional stiffnesses. A bounded a12-forward left-center attempt did not converge and its forces are excluded. The remaining 22 stations retain proxy connectors; these are not LB-14 candidate solves, rated joint demands, G1/G2 closure, or drilling approval. See docs/bolted-candidate-center-design-convergence.md.
